title: Data-driven exploration of Na–Bi compounds: a first-principles and machine learning approach to topological thermoelectrics
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,42034-42050
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05888K, Paper
Open Access

Souraya Goumri-Said, Houssam Eddine Hailouf, Khalid Reggab, Kingsley Onyebuchi Obodo, Mohammed Benali Kanoun
We investigate the structural, electronic, vibrational, thermodynamic, and thermoelectric properties of Na–Bi compounds (NaBi, NaBi3, Na3Bi) using advanced first-principles calculations combined with machine learning models.
